questions.q: Which statement best describes adult polyuria?
questions.exp: Adult polyuria is generally defined as more than 3 L/day. (Book p965)

questions.q: Match the key concept in water diuresis with its correct interpretation.
questions.exp: Water diuresis is characterized by low urine osmolality. (Book p965)

questions.q: A patient is being evaluated for osmotic diuresis. Which finding or action is most appropriate?
questions.exp: Glucose, urea or other solutes can produce osmotic diuresis. (Book p965)

questions.q: In the context of water-balance hormone, the principal ___ is:
questions.exp: ADH permits collecting-duct water reabsorption. (Book p965)

questions.q: Which option is the odd one out regarding central DI?
questions.exp: Central DI reflects deficient ADH synthesis or release. (Book p966)

questions.q: Assess these statements about desmopressin response: I the first statement is correct; II the second statement is incorrect.
opts: Urine concentrates markedly in central DI
Urine remains dilute in all cases
questions.exp: A response to desmopressin indicates preserved renal response with deficient endogenous ADH. (Book p966)

questions.q: What is the characteristic value or relationship for nephrogenic DI cause?
questions.exp: Lithium impairs collecting-duct response to ADH. (Book p966)

questions.q: A clinical decision depends on nephrogenic treatment. Which choice is best?
opts: Remove the cause and reduce solute load
questions.exp: Nephrogenic DI requires cause-directed treatment and safe water replacement. (Book p966)
Glycosuria raises tubular osmolality and urine volume. (Book p967)

questions.q: Match the key concept in primary polydipsia with its correct interpretation.
opts: Dilute urine that concentrates with water deprivation
questions.exp: An intact concentrating response supports primary polydipsia. (Book p967)

questions.q: A patient is being evaluated for water deprivation test. Which finding or action is most appropriate?
questions.exp: Water deprivation tests whether urine can become concentrated. (Book p967)

questions.q: In the context of desmopressin test, the principal ___ is:
questions.exp: Central DI responds more clearly than nephrogenic DI. (Book p967)

questions.q: Which option is the odd one out regarding central DI? in this setting
questions.exp: Replacement ADH is targeted therapy for central DI. (Book p967)

questions.q: Assess these statements about untreated DI: I the first statement is correct; II the second statement is incorrect.
questions.exp: Free-water loss can rapidly cause hypernatremia. (Book p967)

questions.q: What is the characteristic value or relationship for lithium DI?
opts: Stop or replace lithium when feasible
questions.exp: Removing an offending drug is rational when possible. (Book p967)

questions.q: A clinical decision depends on polyuria evaluation. Which choice is best?
opts: Assume diabetes insipidus from thirst alone
questions.exp: Volume and osmolality separate water from solute diuresis. (Book p967)
